anomalies.observed: The net that drives the WS2812 level-shifter enable and the WS2812 ground switch is held low: R58 connects /LED_3.3V_POWER_NONINV to GND, and U34 is an SN74LVC1G07 open-drain buffer whose input A is tied to +3V3, so U34.Y cannot pull the net high. U7.5 is the TXS0101 OE input and Q10.1 is an NMOS gate, both on this same net.
anomalies.expected: For the addressable LEDs to operate, U7 OE and Q10 gate must be able to be driven high (or the net must be pulled up to +3V3 and driven by a suitable switch/driver). The specification states that the board provides addressable status LEDs (WS2812B, D5-D7, D18-D21).

anomalies.impact: The TXS0101 level shifter for the WS2812 data line is disabled and the NMOS low-side switch for the WS2812 ground remains off, so the addressable status LEDs are unlikely to light or respond to GPIO13.

anomalies.observed: Both isolated CAN transceivers have their primary-side and secondary-side grounds tied to the same GND net: U10.4/GND1, U10.5/GND2, U11.4/GND1, and U11.5/GND2 are all on GND.
anomalies.expected: The specification describes two isolated CAN buses implemented through isolated CAN transceivers. An isolated transceiver such as the ISO1050DUB/CA-IS3050G requires separate isolated GND1 and GND2 domains to provide galvanic isolation.
